blocks.task_summary: Find the values of x for which f is decreasing, given f'(x) = 4 + 2x - 3e^x.
method_path: Find critical values by solving f'(x) = 0

evidence.basis: one critical value (seen anywhere) (A1); recognizing that for f to be decreasing f' < 0 (M1); x ≤ -1.74 and x ≥ 0.518 OR x < -1.74 and x > 0.518 A1

blocks.task_summary: Find the values of x for which the graph of f is concave-up.
method_path: Solve inequality to get x < ln(2/3)
accepted_alternatives: Attempt to find maximum of f' OR recognising that f''(x) > 0 OR sketching graph of f''

evidence.basis: correct critical value x = -0.405465... (= ln(2/3)) (seen anywhere) (A1); attempt to find maximum of f' OR recognising that f''(x) > 0 OR sketching graph of f'' OR f''(x) = 2 - 3e^x (M1); concave-up for x < ln(2/3) OR x < -0.405 A1
